description: Start-of-battle Speed tie between Gardevoir (Trace, 132) and Ninetales (Drought + Heat Rock, 132): which SwitchIn handler runs first decides whether Trace's copied Drought sets 5-turn sun (Ninetales' then fails) or Ninetales sets 8-turn sun. Showdown breaks the tie by effectOrder (p1's leads switched in first), not at random. Both sides Protect.
